tools.name: answer
tools.description: Answer the exact decisionId using value in the returned reply.valueSchema; answering can spend turns or produce another question.

value.description: Reply value matching the standing question’s reply.valueSchema. No kind tag is needed.

itemId.description: Exact opaque item id from inventory, here.items or the standing question.

tools.name: apply
tools.description: Apply a perceived carried object.

itemId.description: Exact opaque item id from inventory, here.items or the standing question.

tools.name: attack
tools.description: Force one engine attack at an adjacent square or returned creature reference; leave confirmations explicit.

tools.name: cancel
tools.description: Cancel the standing decision only when it is cancellable.

tools.name: cast
tools.description: Begin casting a learned spell.

tools.name: chat
tools.description: Attempt deliberate conversation in a compass direction.

tools.name: climb

tools.name: close

tools.name: configurePickup
tools.description: Replace automatic ground-pickup settings at a free command boundary without spending a turn.

review.description: Pause automatic pickup at a review decision before transferring anything. Explicit selection or cancellation required.

lootPatterns.description: Case-insensitive literal substrings of the perceived singular item name. Add to category and arrow inclusions; never match hidden identity.

ignorePatterns.description: Case-insensitive literal substrings of the perceived singular item name. Override every inclusion.

tools.name: explore
tools.description: Explore toward unvisited frontiers within maxActions; maxFrontiers explicitly allows successive frontiers (default 1). Stop for changes, decisions, or one door attempt.

maxFrontiers.description: Maximum successive perceived frontiers to reach (default 1). The total maxActions budget and decision/change stops still apply. A door attempt always ends the call.

tools.name: fire
tools.description: Fire the current quiver using normal engine rules.

tools.name: go
tools.description: Walk toward any square on the current level along known routes, stopping on changes or decisions; force:true attempts adjacent ordinary movement only.

tools.name: help
tools.description: List tool names and one-line descriptions, or get one tool schema by name.

tools.description: Read revision-bound attempts for here or an adjacent square using only perceived knowledge.

tools.name: moveWithoutAttack

tools.name: observe
